[EFFECT] The effect of temperature on hourly demand is non-monotonic — it rises and falls across the range. Its shape is non-monotonic, with the contribution highest around ~21.3 C.

[IMPORTANCE] Temperature ranks 3 of 9 features by global importance (importance 0.197) — one of the strongest drivers of demand.

[RECOMMENDATION] Account for temperature when planning bikes and staff: demand is highest around ~21.3 C, so allocate more there and less at the opposite end.
